spec.title: Family tip
lines: Ask them: what did you learn today?
Get it wrong on purpose. They love it!

text:
👨‍👩‍👧 Family tip: let the kids teach you!

After their lesson, ask your little ones to teach you the new words. Get one wrong on purpose and watch them correct you 😄

Explaining a word is one of the best ways to remember it.

Thai, French, Spanish or Italian, free for the whole family 👉 nongchang.co.uk/fb (on Instagram: link in bio)

#familylearning #languagesforkids #learningtogether

🔤 Read Thai: two more letters!

จ = a "j" sound. Its name is จ จาน (jaw jaan), "j for plate" 🍽️
ฉ = a "ch" sound. Its name is ฉ ฉิ่ง (chǎw chìng), "ch for little cymbals" 🔔

Every Thai letter has its own picture word. Learn them all in Read Thai 👉 nongchang.co.uk/fb (on Instagram: link in bio)

#learnthai #thaialphabet #readthai

spec.title: Merry Christmas in 4 languages
lines: สุขสันต์วันคริสต์มาส

text:
🎄 How do you say Merry Christmas?

🇫🇷 Joyeux Noël ! (zhwah-YUH no-EL)
🇪🇸 ¡Feliz Navidad! (feh-LEES nah-vee-DAHD)
🇮🇹 Buon Natale! (bwon nah-TAH-leh)
🇹🇭 สุขสันต์วันคริสต์มาส (sùk-sǎn wan khrít-mâat)

Which one will your family say this year? 🎅

nongchang.co.uk/fb (on Instagram: link in bio)

#merrychristmas #familylearning #languagesforkids

🇫🇷🎄 French Christmas words

le sapin (luh sah-PAN) = the Christmas tree
le cadeau (luh kah-DOH) = the present 🎁
le Père Noël (luh pair no-EL) = Father Christmas 🎅

In France, many families have their big Christmas meal on Christmas Eve, called le réveillon 🍽️

Free French lessons with Coco 👉 nongchang.co.uk/fb (on Instagram: link in bio)

#learnfrench #frenchforkids #noel

🇪🇸👑 Fun fact: in Spain, many children open their presents on 6 January!

los Reyes Magos (lohs REH-yes MAH-gohs) = the Three Kings, who bring the presents

The night before, kids leave their shoes out, and there's a big parade called la cabalgata 🐪

Free Spanish lessons with Torito 👉 nongchang.co.uk/fb (on Instagram: link in bio)

#learnspanish #spanishforkids #reyesmagos

🇮🇹🧹 Fun fact: in Italy, a kind old witch called la Befana (lah beh-FAH-nah) flies on her broom on the night of 5 January!

She fills children's stockings with dolci (DOHL-chee) = sweets 🍬
...or a lump of carbone (kar-BOH-neh) = coal, if they've been naughty! (It's usually sugar coal 😉)

🇹🇭🎁 Thai word of the week

ของขวัญ (khǎwng-khwǎn) = present / gift

Got a present? Say ขอบคุณ (khàwp-khun) = thank you 🙏 Add ครับ (khráp) if you're male, or ค่ะ (khâ) if you're female.

🔤🐘 Read Thai: Nong Chang's own letter!

ช = a "ch" sound. Its name is ช ช้าง (chaw cháang), "ch for elephant"

ช้าง (cháang) = elephant, so น้องช้าง (Nong Chang) starts with this letter too!
